scope: Manual lore/representation assessment, not blanket artistic acceptance or gameplay verification

assessment_meanings.core_match: The main object/product representation is consistent; this does not mean its artistic finish is final.
assessment_meanings.partial: Recognisable identity but missing important material, cultural, construction or functional visual cues.
assessment_meanings.contradiction: A specific stated material, cut, count or product state conflicts with the implementation.
assessment_meanings.ambiguous: Original icon and text leave a genuine interpretive tension; do not silently invent a resolution.

limits: All 101 English descriptions were manually read and compared with rendered studies. The seven corrected natives also have read-only Blender geometry/material inspection.
Technical validation does not certify artistic quality, chemical composition, physical scale, carat mass, biological effects or payload behaviour.
The shared catalogue does not imply a common cultural origin. Authored motifs and ambiguous icon/text relationships remain explicit.
Full procedural materials are native-only; GLB shader graphs remain unbaked.

entries.name: Beers
entries.lore_requirement: Beer is a bulk interspecies commodity.
entries.current_finding: Industrial casks suit the commodity and reused reference packaging.
entries.next_action: Keep robust bulk packaging; brewery labels may improve differentiation.

entries.name: Wines
entries.lore_requirement: Prestige wines travel by the case in containers adapted to loss of gravity.
entries.current_finding: Loose bottles identify wine, but the distinctive shipping protection is absent.
entries.next_action: Add an optional restrained transport case or cradle without replacing the reference bottles.

entries.name: Altarian Panther Sweat
entries.lore_requirement: Panther Sweat is a notorious very strong luxury beverage, not literal animal sweat.
entries.current_finding: The animal-shaped novelty decanter follows the icon and does not imply biological sweat.
entries.next_action: Refine premium beverage presentation; do not literalise the name.

entries.name: St.Etienne's Real Cream & Honey Liqueur
entries.lore_requirement: Designer non-alcoholic cream-and-honey liqueur contains herbal extracts.
entries.current_finding: The bottles are recognisable, but clear glass without distinct creamy contents weakens the product identity.
entries.next_action: Represent opaque cream/honey contents and designer labelling rather than ordinary clear wine.

entries.name: Muet & Champignon vintage champagne
entries.lore_requirement: Vintage champagne is an expensive bulk-traded luxury.
entries.current_finding: Foil-neck champagne bottles are consistent with that identity.
entries.next_action: Keep premium closure/labels; a shipping case is optional context.

entries.name: Fizzimo Lumiere
entries.lore_requirement: Premium Lumiere is a bright green glowing brew shown in crystal urns; cheap grades use opaque jars.
entries.current_finding: Crystal-like urns are appropriate, but emission is attached to the vessel material rather than a distinct brew.
entries.next_action: Separate glowing liquid from crystal shell and show a convincing fill level.

entries.name: Bristol glass
entries.lore_requirement: Bristol makes mouth-blown coloured wine glasses, brandy balloons and champagne flutes only.
entries.current_finding: The model follows the icon's carafe-like centrepiece, which conflicts with the text's restriction.
entries.next_action: Retain the evidence conflict explicitly; establish its intended drinking-vessel form before replacing it.

entries.name: Crystal Cantata Inc. products
entries.lore_requirement: Cantata makes individually commissioned cut glass in runs of at most two dozen of one design.
entries.current_finding: Related cut-crystal vessels fit the bespoke range and small group size.
entries.next_action: Improve distinct cutting patterns and hand-finished variation; do not turn it into mass-produced identical stock.

entries.name: Deep pile velvet
entries.lore_requirement: Velvet is a luxury fabric with deep pile.
entries.current_finding: The roll/sheet and matte tinted sheen identify velvet.
entries.next_action: Refine visible pile and soft edge thickness at close range.

entries.name: Silk
entries.lore_requirement: Silk is a luxury fabric popular with several cultures.
entries.current_finding: A draped silk roll is suitable; directional sheen differentiates it from velvet.
entries.next_action: Keep a fine weave and restrained lustre rather than lacquer-like highlights.

entries.name: Watered silk
entries.lore_requirement: Watered silk owes its rarity to a complex weave.
entries.current_finding: The roll is suitable but the distinctive watered/moire appearance is weak after generic fabric shading.
entries.next_action: Restore a deliberate moire weave rather than only random noise.

entries.name: Raw silk
entries.lore_requirement: Raw silk has a particular texture appreciated by Achaeans and Mikotaj.
entries.current_finding: The rougher matte roll is consistent; the lore's sound preference is not visible in a still.
entries.next_action: Strengthen irregular slubs and coarse fibres without claiming an implemented acoustic effect.

entries.name: Satin taffeta
entries.lore_requirement: Satin taffeta is a rare, expensive social fabric.
entries.current_finding: The sheet/roll and directional highlights are appropriate.
entries.next_action: Refine fine weave and crisp folds while retaining its difference from silk.

entries.name: Egyptian sea-cotton
entries.lore_requirement: Old Terran Egyptian sea-cotton is exceptionally fine and expensive.
entries.current_finding: The pale cotton roll is compatible with the product.
entries.next_action: Use convincing fine fibres and soft edges; provenance cannot be proved by shape alone.

entries.name: Achaean angora
entries.lore_requirement: Achaean angora is combed fur from pet felines.
entries.current_finding: The yarn spool is plausible, but looks more like a smooth wound thread than soft feline angora.
entries.next_action: Add a restrained fuzzy fibre halo and irregular yarn strands.

entries.name: Tiara & Bracelet set
entries.lore_requirement: The tiara/bracelet set is raw opal with metachrome.
entries.current_finding: The separate tiara and bracelet now use unfaceted raw opals and metachrome settings/chain; introduced diamond identities are removed.
entries.next_action: Further refine opal colour play and jewellery workmanship without changing the two-piece composition.

previous_review.current_finding: Current material slots include a diamond jewel and white-gold/platinum settings, not a consistently opal/metachrome set.

material_names: TI016 / raw opal / milky natural colour play

entries.name: Choker
entries.lore_requirement: A woven red-gold band carries an eight-point gold sunburst, central aquamarine and scattered brilliants.
entries.current_finding: The band, sunburst and centre exist; woven construction and surrounding brilliants are missing.
entries.next_action: Model the woven ribbon and scattered small stones; preserve the eight-point motif.

entries.name: Solitaire emerald
entries.lore_requirement: A square-cut emerald must be set in white gold.
entries.current_finding: The revised emerald has a square seven-ring step cut with small chamfered corners, white-gold bezel and corner claws.
entries.next_action: Retain the square cut and white-gold identity during future detail work.

previous_review.current_finding: The setting is visibly yellow gold and is assigned the yellow-gold material; the stone also reads as a generic octagon.

material_names: TI018 / white gold square solitaire setting

entries.name: Brooch
entries.lore_requirement: The brooch uses a cabochon-cut ruby with red gold and copper.
entries.current_finding: The revised ruby is a smooth domed cabochon, with actual sheet thickness and visibly differentiated red-gold/copper petals.
entries.next_action: Further engraving is optional; retain the unfaceted cabochon and two metals.

previous_review.current_finding: The ruby is faceted despite the cabochon material name; red-gold/copper differentiation is weak.

entries.name: Necklace
entries.lore_requirement: Exactly 23 astramarines are set in white gold and titanium.
entries.current_finding: Actual Blender inspection counts 23 astramarines and white-gold bezels, with 22 titanium links; the studio render is visibly a pale setting.
entries.next_action: Retain the exact stone count and white-gold/titanium distinction.

previous_review.current_finding: The 23-stone structure is present, but all bezels/links use yellow gold.

entries.name: Eternity ring
entries.lore_requirement: The eternity ring combines ultropaz and alexandrite in 24ct yellow gold.
entries.current_finding: The yellow-gold ring now carries four amber ultropaz and four violet-studio-state alexandrite gems; pearl/astramarine identities are removed.
entries.next_action: Refine the tiny settings; dynamic alexandrite colour change remains unimplemented and is not certified by this still.

previous_review.current_finding: The current stones use astramarine and pearl materials instead.

material_names: TI021 / ultropaz / warm amber transparent gem

entries.name: Pectoral
entries.lore_requirement: The pectoral combines diamond, emerald and metachrome.
entries.current_finding: The gem/lattice composition is recognisable, but the framework is labelled white gold/platinum rather than metachrome.
entries.next_action: Give the framework a deliberate metachrome identity; refine lattice workmanship.

entries.name: Collar
entries.lore_requirement: Seventeen blue opals are paired with a white-gold clasp.
entries.current_finding: Stone count and pale clasp are present; the stones share an astramarine-style transparent shader.
entries.next_action: Give blue opals their own material character and refine their settings.

entries.name: 3-strand bracelet
entries.lore_requirement: The bracelet has three pearl strands and platinum.
entries.current_finding: The model has three strands, pearls and a pale metallic clasp.
entries.next_action: Refine nacre lustre and the clasp; do not add arbitrary gemstones.

entries.name: Diamond
entries.lore_requirement: The item is diamond; its reputation is a cultural/marketing point.
entries.current_finding: Faceted clear warm stones are appropriate.
entries.next_action: Keep diamond-like refraction; rarity is not a visual acceptance criterion.

entries.name: Emerald
entries.lore_requirement: Emeralds are rare and flawless specimens are exceptionally unusual.
entries.current_finding: Green faceted stones identify emerald; the current stones are unusually clean.
entries.next_action: Subtle inclusions would suit common trade specimens, but flawless examples are not forbidden by lore.

entries.name: Sapphire
entries.lore_requirement: Sapphires may be blue, yellow or white.
entries.current_finding: Blue faceted stones are a valid selection.
entries.next_action: Additional colour variants are optional, not required corrections.

entries.name: Ruby
entries.lore_requirement: Rubies are rarer than diamonds.
entries.current_finding: Red faceted stones are compatible.
entries.next_action: Retain ruby colour/absorption; economic rarity cannot be inferred from a still.

entries.name: Ultropaz
entries.lore_requirement: Ultropaz comes from a few remote planets.
entries.current_finding: Amber stones follow the icon; the text does not specify optical properties.
entries.next_action: Treat the optical response as an interpretation, not a measured canonical material.

entries.name: Alexandrite
entries.lore_requirement: Alexandrite changes colour between natural and artificial illumination.
entries.current_finding: A fixed purple shader depicts one condition but not the defining change.
entries.next_action: Provide a paired-light study or a controlled colour-change material; avoid claiming current behaviour is implemented.

entries.name: Metachrome
entries.lore_requirement: Metachrome can be cut as a gem and melted into settings.
entries.current_finding: The cut-stone state is a valid representation of one use.
entries.next_action: Keep its dual gem/setting identity consistent across jewellery; exact optics remain speculative.

entries.name: Opal
entries.lore_requirement: Opal is a culturally prized Old Terran gem.
entries.current_finding: Generic clear faceted green glass with inclusions is weakly distinct as opal.
entries.next_action: Develop opal-like body colour/colour play as a visual interpretation, guided by the icon.

entries.name: Pearl
entries.lore_requirement: Pearls retain their lustre and are especially prized by Artemia.
entries.current_finding: Smooth lustrous pearls are appropriate.
entries.next_action: Refine nacre and small natural irregularities without making them faceted stones.

entries.name: Moonstone
entries.lore_requirement: Moonstone is a revived semi-precious gem popular across cultures.
entries.current_finding: A generic faceted green shader is not very distinctive as moonstone.
entries.next_action: Explore restrained moonstone-like internal sheen; that material detail is an analogue, not specified game physics.

entries.name: Astramarine
entries.lore_requirement: Astramarine is a sophisticated Mikotaj gift.
entries.current_finding: Cyan gems follow the reference and suit a precious gift commodity.
entries.next_action: Exact optical behaviour is unspecified; keep its identity distinct from blue opal in other items.

entries.name: Peridot
entries.lore_requirement: Peridot is especially valued by Braccatia as the colour of honour.
entries.current_finding: Yellow-green stones preserve the relevant colour association.
entries.next_action: Keep this colour identity; do not invent heraldic text as recovered canon.

entries.name: Amethyst
entries.lore_requirement: Amethyst remains popular despite a false historical sobriety belief.
entries.current_finding: Purple stones represent the gem correctly.
entries.next_action: Do not turn the historical belief into a functioning protective effect.

entries.name: Abstract Sculpture
entries.lore_requirement: Artemian abstract sculpture is meaningful metalwork, prized by collectors.
entries.current_finding: Curved metal forms on a plinth fit the description.
entries.next_action: Refine intentional form/line and craft; emotional meaning is not independently verifiable.

entries.name: Domestic interior units
entries.lore_requirement: Artemian furniture blends sculpture with exotic-metal curves and planes.
entries.current_finding: The curved table fits; the generic shelf and storage block poorly express that sculptural culture.
entries.next_action: Remodel the set as coherent sculptural metal furniture, preserving the reference composition.

entries.name: Decorative drinking horns
entries.lore_requirement: Braccatian export horns are oversized decorative work with Saxon/Celtic affinities.
entries.current_finding: Horns and metal bands fit; distinctive workmanship and relative scale are underdeveloped.
entries.next_action: Develop carved/knot-like bands from reference evidence; keep ceremonial originals distinct from export decoration.

entries.name: Worked leather
entries.lore_requirement: Braccatian leatherwork is exceptional, custom-made and the finest pieces are rarely legally traded.
entries.current_finding: The remodelled tailored coat, boots and belt now show thickness, folds and raised decoration.
entries.next_action: Continue fine leather craft and culturally compatible ornament; do not label invented details as recovered.

entries.name: Ornamental archaic weaponry
entries.lore_requirement: Braccatian exports are elegant, archaic ornamental weapons.
entries.current_finding: Sword/flail fit; the third flat triangle with bars loses the handled ornate blade seen in the icon and is described inconsistently as an instrument.
entries.next_action: Resolve the triangular weapon/guard geometry and grip; do not reinterpret it as a harp from the bars alone.

entries.name: Fizzimo Liqueurs
entries.lore_requirement: Four quail-egg-sized dark chocolates contain glowing Lumiere and come in an exquisite box.
entries.current_finding: Four chocolate orbs and a decorative box are present; confectionery craftsmanship is very basic.
entries.next_action: Refine the box/interior and edible chocolate finish; a cutaway could clarify filling but closed orbs need not expose it.

entries.name: Rigellian ant eggs
entries.lore_requirement: Eggs of metre-tall Rigellian ants are a costly delicacy.
entries.current_finding: Large smooth egg shapes are consistent.
entries.next_action: Improve shell texture; racial scale is not verifiable from display-normalised objects alone.

entries.name: Pearls dissolved in brandy
entries.lore_requirement: The snack consists of pearls dissolved in brandy.
entries.current_finding: The flask now has an actual hollow glass wall and amber brandy volume with subtle nacre scattering; there are no whole pearl bead objects. The current render was inspected.
entries.next_action: Further develop the delicate dissolved-nacre appearance and authored bottle label; do not reintroduce intact pearls.

previous_review.current_finding: The flask contains many intact spherical objects named undissolved pearls and lacks a distinct brandy medium.

material_names: TI045 / brandy with dissolved pearl / amber opalescent liquid
TI045 / clear hollow brandy flask glass

entries.name: Goat's ear mushrooms
entries.lore_requirement: Goats' ear mushrooms are a rare, limited-harvest delicacy.
entries.current_finding: Mushrooms are recognisable, but current caps/stems remain generic.
entries.next_action: Use the original cap shapes and organic detail to establish species character without assuming the name dictates exact anatomy.

entries.name: Organic corn on the cob
entries.lore_requirement: Sweetcorn is scarce premium organic produce, favoured by vegetarian Artemia.
entries.current_finding: Individual kernels/cobs in a produce crate match the commodity.
entries.next_action: Keep fresh organic character rather than depicting the blight as the sale product.

entries.name: Braccatian kulos cheese
entries.lore_requirement: Kulos cheese is rare, dense and nourishing dairy from a low-yield animal.
entries.current_finding: A waxed cut cheese wheel is consistent; hole/wax details follow the icon, not explicit lore.
entries.next_action: Retain repaired cut-face topology; develop realistic rind/wax/curd texture in later refinement.

entries.name: Grains
entries.lore_requirement: Grains are basic bulk staples across species.
entries.current_finding: Bulk sacks are a sensible representation.
entries.next_action: Improve folds, ties and cloth construction; no specific grain anatomy is mandated for sealed sacks.

entries.name: Seaweed
entries.lore_requirement: Marine kelp, phosphoran and mossweed are inexpensive staples.
entries.current_finding: Lattice crates fit bulk cargo, but generic green ovals read more as leaves than marine fronds.
entries.next_action: Refine ribbon/frond/branching forms while preserving the cargo arrangement.

entries.name: Krill
entries.lore_requirement: Krill is a cheap freeze-dried survival staple.
entries.current_finding: Plain bulk canisters fit dry processed food.
entries.next_action: Keep utilitarian packaging; do not make it a fresh seafood luxury display.

entries.name: Water
entries.lore_requirement: Clean water is precious, heavily shipped and legally protected.
entries.current_finding: A rack of sealed bulk tanks fits this role.
entries.next_action: Cargo/water identification may help; the contents need not be visible through metal tanks.

entries.name: Ortok's Mansions
entries.lore_requirement: Ortok's Mansions has ten truth and ten deceit mansions, Tarot-like player pieces and a highest truth goal.
entries.current_finding: The corrected set has ten truth and ten deceit locations across six tiers, the highest truth goal and four illustrative arcana-like character tokens. Its boards, staircase and craftsmanship remain simpler than the icon.
entries.next_action: Add the sculpted staircase and richer Rigellian workmanship while preserving the verified 20-location split; the token motifs/colour coding remain authored interpretations.

previous_review.current_finding: The generator makes six tiers with four miniature houses each: 24 mansions, with no distinct Tarot-like player pieces.

entries.name: Shades of Brutos
entries.lore_requirement: Brutos's unique fear-sensitive goggles are historical Maunid military memorabilia.
entries.current_finding: The goggles are recognisable but generic; fear sensing itself is not visible in a still.
entries.next_action: Refine a distinctive historical instrument and wear; do not invent the unknown mechanism as canon.

entries.name: Huskar Cigars
entries.lore_requirement: Huskar cigars are brown-paper rolls in brilliant wooden boxes; smoke is purple if lit.
entries.current_finding: The coloured wooden box and brown cigars fit an unlit product display.
entries.next_action: Refine wrappers/brand craftsmanship; any later lit view must use purple smoke.

entries.name: Maunik's Cube
entries.lore_requirement: Maunik's Cube is a heavy, oily metal puzzle with uncoloured faces bearing Law-of-the-Cube slogans.
entries.current_finding: The 3x3 metal cube fits, but repeated crosses do not convey inscriptions and the finish is rather dry.
entries.next_action: Add oily metal response and authored inscription-like strokes without claiming readable canonical language.

entries.name: Gong of Death Song
entries.lore_requirement: The unique gong marks a foundational Braccatian uprising.
entries.current_finding: A suspended historical gong fits the object.
entries.next_action: Develop singular craftsmanship and age; avoid inventing a recovered revolutionary emblem.

entries.name: Holostar globes
entries.lore_requirement: HoloStar Globes are holographic charts of limited explored space, kept as family heirlooms.
entries.current_finding: The glass globe/stand is plausible, but latitude bands suggest a globe more than a holographic star chart.
entries.next_action: Add a legible internal star/route-sector composition rather than a generic planet globe.

entries.name: Besthelda's Apothecary
entries.lore_requirement: Besthelda's Apothecary is a rare boxed collection of expertly compounded natural remedies.
entries.current_finding: A fitted case with many glass vials fits the collection.
entries.next_action: Refine differentiated contents, stoppers and historical hand-labelled craft.

entries.name: Photoplasmic Cocoon
entries.lore_requirement: Photoplasmic cocoons contain modulated frozen light for therapy.
entries.current_finding: The glowing egg/suspended spheres hint at light, but read mainly as a glass ornament.
entries.next_action: Develop structured luminous photoplasm and a coherent therapeutic enclosure; exact mechanism/scale is unspecified.

entries.name: Steam Racers
entries.lore_requirement: Steam Racers are heavy Braccatian steam-era arena machines with rear explosive-harpoon tailgunners.
entries.current_finding: Boiler, stacks, wheels and a rear gun are present, but the model is toy-like and lacks a convincing tailgunner emplacement.
entries.next_action: Refine a heavy classic steam racer with readable rear gunner station, not a generic toy locomotive.

entries.name: KKZ Quad
entries.lore_requirement: KKZ Quad uses one 100-card deck for two duellists and two magistrates; execution cards define the dangerous game.
entries.current_finding: Generic green decks and pip-like faces read as ordinary playing cards.
entries.next_action: Establish the deck/four-role identity and authored execution-card language visually, with restrained sealed technical details.

entries.name: Kraagil Oil
entries.lore_requirement: Kraagil Oil comes from an endangered whale/dragon-like aquatic crustacean.
entries.current_finding: The original icon depicts the animal; the model preserves this metonymy but reduces it to a spiked segmented form.
entries.next_action: Refine the specific head/body/frond anatomy; do not replace the canonical animal icon automatically with a generic oil bottle.

entries.name: Sacrificial Axe
entries.lore_requirement: The axe is a revered, rare Artemian ritual object associated with Moon Goddess Cyreni.
entries.current_finding: The rebuilt solid crescent head and turned haft follow the reference; the new craft pass uses recessed lunar metalwork and carved wood.
entries.next_action: Keep it a carefully made sacred artefact; lunar motifs are an authored interpretation, and rumoured sacrifice does not establish blood decoration.

entries.name: Horn of Plenty
entries.lore_requirement: The Horn of Plenty is an actual Braccatian ritual horn, unlike decorative export examples.
entries.current_finding: The single larger ornamented horn and chain distinguish it somewhat from the export set.
entries.next_action: Refine unique ceremonial workmanship, historic use and ornament rather than only scaling the common horn.

entries.name: Dionne's Lightwork
entries.lore_requirement: Dionne's Lightwork is a singular famous artwork by Flic Spens.
entries.current_finding: The composition follows the icon, but a primitive figure and planes poorly express a finished masterpiece.
entries.next_action: Refine the intentional sculptural form, pedestal and light medium; do not substitute an unrelated realistic portrait.

entries.name: Loving Cup
entries.lore_requirement: The loving cup is an Achaean communal ritual centrepiece with individual history.
entries.current_finding: The corrected hollow cup is appropriate; handle clearance is now verified.
entries.next_action: Refine individual handwork/history; red lining versus contents remains an icon interpretation, not settled lore.

entries.name: Law of the Cube
entries.lore_requirement: Law of the Cube is a rare Maunid holy book in an obsolete script.
entries.current_finding: The cubic reliquary follows the icon, but a few strokes barely communicate a sacred text.
entries.next_action: Develop inscription/reliquary detail; do not assume an alien book must be a Terran paper codex or invent a translation.

entries.name: Biofort (Pharmaceutical)
entries.lore_requirement: Biofort is a spacer medicine and the specific counter to Silicon Death.
entries.current_finding: A medical case and vials fit the referenced product.
entries.next_action: Use unambiguous product identification; therapeutic effect is not validated by a prop model.

entries.name: Vir-Attack (Pharmaceutical)
entries.lore_requirement: Vir-Attack is a broad in-universe medicine with specific exclusions and APV counters.
entries.current_finding: Medical packaging and vials are suitable.
entries.next_action: Avoid claiming it cures every named condition; appearance alone cannot prove efficacy.

entries.name: Supa-Shellac (Pharmaceutical)
entries.lore_requirement: Supa-Shellac treats Artemian chitin rot and is unusable by Terrans.
entries.current_finding: The labelled medicine bottle is appropriate.
entries.next_action: Keep its Artemian medical identity; do not present it as a Terran cosmetic despite the name.

entries.name: Swat (Pharmaceutical)
entries.lore_requirement: Swat is the counter to the Artemia-targeting Shell Shock APV.
entries.current_finding: The sprayer can depict a medical preparation.
entries.next_action: Keep treatment identity clear rather than implying it is a weapon against Artemia.

entries.name: Star Balm (Pharmaceutical)
entries.lore_requirement: Star Balm is a Mikotaj-produced antidote to Astrophobia.
entries.current_finding: The labelled balm bottle is compatible.
entries.next_action: Use Mikotaj product identity and keep the Astrophobia association clear in the catalogue.

entries.name: Shell Shock (APV)
entries.lore_requirement: Shell Shock is an agent-delivered fictional APV targeting Artemia; Swat is its counter.
entries.current_finding: A portable sealed case fits the delivery role.
entries.next_action: Keep it distinct from the missile inventory; biological gameplay function is not visually validated.

entries.name: Phantom (APV)
entries.lore_requirement: Phantom is an agent-delivered fictional APV affecting Mikotaj.
entries.current_finding: A carried sealed container is compatible.
entries.next_action: Use product identity rather than inventing an unsupported visible mechanism.

entries.name: Judgement Day (APV)
entries.lore_requirement: Judgement Day is a delayed agent-delivered fictional APV for several species.
entries.current_finding: A guarded portable payload canister is plausible.
entries.next_action: Do not turn it into a conventional launchable missile merely because of the shape.

entries.name: Silicon Death (APV)
entries.lore_requirement: Silicon Death is an agent-delivered fictional APV with a particular species pattern.
entries.current_finding: The carried sealed barrel is compatible with the icon.
entries.next_action: Keep product and counterpart Biofort distinct; do not literalise the name as an asteroid-dissolving missile.

entries.name: Selenium Ore
entries.lore_requirement: Selenium is low-grade construction and missile ore.
entries.current_finding: Generic reused casks match the actual reference reuse.
entries.next_action: Cargo labels can distinguish content; beer-cask reuse alone is not a lore error.

entries.name: Asteros Ore
entries.lore_requirement: Asteros is low-grade ore used to run the Powerplant.
entries.current_finding: The same bulk-cask family is icon-compatible.
entries.next_action: Retain resource identity in metadata/labels; no unique ore appearance is specified.

entries.name: Barium Ore
entries.lore_requirement: Barium is low-grade construction/missile/satellite ore.
entries.current_finding: Bulk casks suit the reference and commodity.
entries.next_action: Do not infer real-world barium chemistry from the shared name.

entries.name: Crystalite Ore
entries.lore_requirement: Crystalite is low-grade small-craft/Destructor/Vortex ore.
entries.current_finding: The reused cask packaging is canonical to the icon.
entries.next_action: The name does not require visible crystals when the cargo is sealed.

entries.name: Quazinc Ore
entries.lore_requirement: Quazinc is medium-grade ore for Napalm and Hellfire missiles.
entries.current_finding: The canister and separate yellow sample suit the reference.
entries.next_action: Improve mineral morphology; exact optical/physical properties are unspecified.

entries.name: Bytanium Ore
entries.lore_requirement: Bytanium is medium-grade SpaceDock/Nuclear ore.
entries.current_finding: The canister and brown sample fit the icon.
entries.next_action: Keep sample colour/reference identity without inventing nuclear behaviour for the ore prop.

entries.name: Korellium Ore
entries.lore_requirement: Korellium is medium-grade cruiser/Stasis ore.
entries.current_finding: The canister and grey sample are compatible.
entries.next_action: Do not add ice simply because one consumer is a Stasis missile.

entries.current_finding: Reinforced cases and a purple-grey sample follow the icon.
entries.next_action: Refine the mineral surface; no dragon anatomy is implied by the name.

entries.next_action: Keep its economic identity separate from an assertion that it is itself a warhead.

entries.current_finding: The related, differentiated warhead family is suitable.
entries.next_action: Blast radius is a gameplay property, not proved by model size.

entries.name: Napalm Missile
entries.lore_requirement: Napalm is an advanced plasma-gas incendiary device in this setting.
entries.current_finding: The specialised heat/payload assembly is compatible.
entries.next_action: Avoid assuming a literal historical Terran fuel recipe or bottle form.

entries.name: Hellfire Missile
entries.lore_requirement: Hellfire carries a destructive substance that spreads over an asteroid.
entries.current_finding: A specialised sealed missile is plausible.
entries.next_action: Spreading behaviour requires a separate gameplay/VFX check, not a different still by default.

entries.name: Scatter Missile
entries.lore_requirement: Scatter deploys several conventional explosive missiles over the target.
entries.current_finding: The carrier-like form hints at a special payload, but the sub-missile role is not clearly demonstrated.
entries.next_action: Provide a readable payload-bay/separation study without claiming current deployment animation exists.

entries.name: Vortex Missile
entries.lore_requirement: Vortex releases a wandering electrical storm.
entries.current_finding: The specialised missile form is compatible.
entries.next_action: Keep later VFX electrical; the name does not imply a black hole or gravitational vortex.

entries.name: Nuclear Missile
entries.lore_requirement: Nuclear destroys structures and orbiting ships.
entries.current_finding: The marked nuclear missile is consistent.
entries.next_action: Yield cannot be judged from display-normalised prop dimensions.

entries.name: Virus Missile
entries.lore_requirement: Virus dissolves asteroid material rather than describing the personnel APVs.
entries.current_finding: The chemical/payload-like missile is compatible.
entries.next_action: Keep it distinct from human/species infection imagery and the APV medicine family.

entries.name: Anti-Virus Missile
entries.lore_requirement: Anti-Virus neutralises an asteroid virus and then itself.
entries.current_finding: A related neutralising missile is suitable.
entries.next_action: Do not confuse it with crew pharmaceuticals or a universal biological cure.

entries.name: Mega Missile
entries.lore_requirement: Mega destroys an entire asteroid.
entries.current_finding: A substantial specialised warhead is compatible.
entries.next_action: Magnitude is a gameplay property; a still does not validate destructive capacity.

entries.name: Stasis Missile
entries.lore_requirement: Stasis suspends an asteroid through temporal physics.
entries.current_finding: The field-like missile presentation is compatible.
entries.next_action: Do not render it as a literal ice or refrigeration weapon.

entries.name: Bug Hunter Missile
entries.lore_requirement: Bug Hunter is an Artemia-specific fictional APV delivered by missile.
entries.current_finding: The missile rather than portable-case form is correct.
entries.next_action: Keep its target/function identity in the catalogue; the prop does not validate a biological effect.

entries.name: Meat-Eater Missile
entries.lore_requirement: Meat-Eater is a fictional APV missile for Achaean, Braccatian and Terran populations.
entries.current_finding: The dedicated missile form fits the delivery role.
entries.next_action: Do not literalise the name with teeth or confuse it with the asteroid Virus payload.

entries.name: Information
entries.lore_requirement: Information is illicit data about a subject supplied through the %s placeholder.
entries.current_finding: A folio is a valid reference-derived symbol for information; its strokes do not invent a fixed subject.
entries.next_action: Keep the subject dynamic and avoid claiming the authored strokes are recovered text.
